intelligence.human_view: The test is the whole proposal in one line: a question earns its place only if it matches you on something — a person, or a piece of content. A question that matches nothing is a question that spies. And the answering is the kindness: multiple choice with examples (one tap), type your own any time, dropdowns where a list fits — enter or skip, each question its own on/off. What he added is what the list was missing: the life itself — fitness, drink, smoke, weed, coffee or tea, pets, hobbies, sports, "what's your thing". What the captain added is what makes it a whole person: life stage, what you care about, background, how you like to connect, learning, travel. "Bring back the question to you" is the working method made visible: he asks, the captain proposes, he decides — and he decided, with a 👍 at 16:50Z. The set is ratified; the settings round builds it.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a magic friend who wants to find you the perfect playmates! The friend asks you questions — but ONLY questions that help find someone like you! Where are you from? What do you love? Do you like dogs or cats? Coffee or tea? And you can answer by tapping, or typing your own answer, or skipping any question you like! Every answer helps the friend find people just like you!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the system asks you lovely questions so it can find people just like you. But every question has to earn its place, dear — it only stays if it helps match you with a person or a piece of content you would love. Twenty-nine questions, in seven little groups: where you are, who you are, what you believe, what you do, what you love, how you live, and what you want. You answer by tapping, or typing your own words, or skipping — each question your choice, each one you can switch on or off.
intelligence.naya_view: The perfect set (RATIFIED by his 👍 16:50Z): 29 questions, 7 groups. The test: "what does this match you on?" — a person, or a piece of content. Answer by tap, type, or dropdown; every question enter-or-skip, every one its own on/off. Every answer feeds the match percentage in what area.
